name: TC-AN-QB-010 — UI布局：三按钮位于「已选参与人」同行右侧 [P0]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { /* 查找已选参与人标签和三个快捷按钮的位置关系 */ const allEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')); const labelEl = allEls.find(el => { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '已选参与人：' || t === '已选参与人' || t.startsWith('已选参与人'); }); if (!labelEl) return { found: false, error: '未找到已选参与人标签' }; const labelRect = labelEl.getBoundingClientRect(); const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const targetBtns = btns.filter(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '复制' || t === '批量填写' || t === '清空'; }); const btnInfo = targetBtns.map(b => { const rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return { text: b.textContent.trim(), top: Math.round(rect.top), left: Math.round(rect.left), labelTop: Math.round(labelRect.top), sameRow: Math.abs(rect.top - labelRect.top) < 20 }; }); return { found: true, labelTop: Math.round(labelRect.top), labelLeft: Math.round(labelRect.left), buttons: btnInfo, allSameRow: btnInfo.every(b => b.sameRow), buttonCount: btnInfo.length }; })()
steps.description: 验证三按钮与标签同行

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 进入审核节点编辑页\n2. 定位「已选参与人：」标签\n3. 检查同行右侧是否有「复制」「批量填写」「清空」三个按钮
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 三个按钮均存在于「已选参与人：」标签同一行右侧\n2. 按钮顺序为: 复制、批量填写、清空\n3. 不影响已有的筛选器和下拉组件
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
